plan.question: Download the filtered comparison table for Gaya and Nalanda, 2021 to 2023

insights.message: This file contains only counts of registered pregnancies and completed checkups by district and year. It has no information on facility access, staffing, transport, community awareness, or any other factor that could explain why one district outperforms another. The data can show that a gap exists and how large it is, but it cannot explain the cause.
